parsed.claim_reason: Each subset sum of 1, 2, 4, ..., 2^n is a sum of distinct powers of two, giving the unique binary expansion of an integer in [0, 2^(n+1) - 1]. Distinct subsets give distinct binary expansions, so all 2^(n+1) subset sums are pairwise distinct.
